passages.text: The council approved a draconian, reckless scheme on Tuesday that critics say will siphon funds from repairs.
Officials refused to explain why they allowed the backlog to grow. Residents were told nothing for months.
Members must either approve the levy or watch the district collapse entirely.
The audit was published by the finance office, which recorded a 12 percent shortfall against a Category 4 storm repair budget.
"This is an outrageous betrayal of tenants," said tenant representative Dana Whitfield.
